summary.text: Thaddeus Jones is a Democratic Illinois state representative who has represented District 29 since 2011 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He previously served as an alderman in Calumet City and is president of Time Entertainment, Inc.

paragraphs.text: Thaddeus Jones earned a bachelor's degree from Loyola University and lists his profession as president of Time Entertainment, Inc.
He previously served as an alderman of the City of Calumet City.
Jones has represented District 29 in the Illinois House since 2011 and advanced from the Democratic primary on March 17, 2026.
